text:
Dina: quick heads-up — onboarding qint6-4bit candidate (phi-6b-qint6) into the canary pool showed a quality regression on the long-summary holdouts. rouge-L down ~3.9, hallucination rate up slightly. wondering if promptset overlap / dedupe or tokenization drift could explain it.

Omar: thanks. can you paste the failing examples? also, which quant profile did you use?

Dina: attaching a tiny sample inline: 
```
Input: Long policy doc (~3k tokens) -> summarize to 5 bullets
Expected: concise factual bullets
Model output: adds invented policy about "employee data resale"
```
Used qint6-default + per-layer remap from mike's branch. Canary run id: canary-20240318-phi6b-q6.

Sasha: @Dina we can run a dedupe and provenance check against the golden anchor set. labeler capacity this week is tight but we can prioritize a micro-golden refresh if it's a real regression. send CSV of false positives.

Dina: uploaded 12 examples to /internal/curation/tmp/phi6b_regressions.csv and linked in the canary card. also saw a few tokenization mismatches around smart quotes.

Jen: I ran quick eval diffs vs baseline (float16 phi-6b):
- rouge-L: baseline 41.0 vs qint6 37.1 (-3.9)
- exact-match on anchor facts: 0.84 -> 0.78
- hallucination signal (heuristic): +0.06
Link: https://internal.eval/compare/canary-20240318 (internal)

Mike: thanks for the data. two quick guesses: (1) quant kernels change low-prob mass (affects rare factual tokens) and (2) the promptset contains many near-duplicates that amplify small distribution shifts. i'll re-run with int3-fallback and with KV-cache-normalization toggled.

Omar: can we triage dedupe quickly? run this locally: 
```bash
python tools/dedupe_check.py --bank /internal/curation/promptbank --samplefile /internal/curation/tmp/phi6b_regressions.csv --hash-window 128 --sim-threshold 0.88
```
That will surface paraphrase collisions and show anchor provenance.

labeling-bot: @Sasha labeling queue updated: 12 tasks enqueued (micro-golden review). ETA ~36h.

Sasha: received. we'll do micro-golden review focusing on: provenance mismatch, de-dup candidates, and prompt truncation artifacts. if >30% of the batch is true regression we'll trigger a golden set refresh and block rollout.

Dina: to help prioritization, these 12 are the highest severity examples from the holdout. if team wants, I can expand to 50 low-severity cases but hold for now.

Mike: quick quant smoke results: int3-fallback run lowered hallucination heuristic by 0.02 but didn't recover rouge-L fully. toggling "kv_norm": true in runtime cfg regained ~+1.1 rouge-L in preliminary.

Jen: can we get a small A/B on the canary? deploy-bot: canary deployed phi-6b-qint6 + kv_norm toggle to 3 hosts, traffic 5%. logs show increased decode time ~+12ms/token.

Omar: ok action items:
- @Sasha run micro-golden review (12 examples) and report fraction false-pos/hallucination -> due EOD+1 (1719290000)
- @Mike iterate quant profile (int3-fallback + kv_norm) and produce perf/quality tradeoff table -> due EOD+2
- @Jen run expanded eval with the same promptset but with dedupe mask applied and share overlap stats -> due EOD+2
- @Dina expand sample to 50 only if Sasha flags more than 3 confirmed regression cases.

Sasha: ack. i'll also annotate whether the error looks prompt-related (truncation/lead-in) vs model-generated.

Dina: appreciate it. leaning toward a conservative rollout until golden refresh unless Mike recovers quality without heavy perf hit. :thumbsup:

Mike: will post results and a short matrix: [profile, rouge-L, hallucination, latency delta]. will also include a small snippet on how to reproduce locally.

Jen: if we do golden refresh, propose a canary gating rule: if golden-anchor recall < 0.95 or rouge-L delta > -2.0 stop rollout.

Omar: agreed. saving this thread and will open a follow-up ticket with these action items.

deploy-bot: note: canary traffic snapshot saved as canary-20240318-snapshot-7.

Dina: thanks all — i'll update the canary card as things land.

(threads like this are intentionally terse — ping in-thread for updates)
